posts.body:
good evening I need a lot of help because I can't find it anywhere. I have rpg maker 2003, it wants me to make a spot (map) that is dark except for the player and around it will be bright
tnks.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Google "lightmap rpg maker 2003" or "lightmap rpg maker 2000". Instead of "lightmap" also try "light effect". These are the keywords you need.

posts.author: Strahl
posts.body:
Make yourself a picture that's all black with a transparent circle in the center. The image should be 640x480. png format 256 colors.
While in the game, show the picture and have it scroll with map. There's probably some extra steps needed as you approach the edges of the maps. You could probably have the transparent circle follow the player x and y coordinates using variables and a parallel event that always updates it.
